## Kona Low analysis for paper

```{r}
library(blackmarbler)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(geodata)
library(lubridate)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

bearer <- Sys.getenv("NASA_BEARER")

```

### Dates

```{r}
all_dates <- list(
  baseline = seq.Date(from = ymd("2025-05-01"), to = ymd("2025-08-03"), by = "day"),
  storm1   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-10"), to = ymd("2026-03-16"), by = "day"),
  gap      = ymd("2026-03-18"),
  storm2   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-19"), to = ymd("2026-03-24"), by = "day")
)
```

### creating folder

```{r}
vol <- "/media/volume/fhardie-ntl-data"
ntl_dir <- file.path(vol, "ntl_baseline")
h5_dir <- file.path(vol, "ntl_h5_raw")

dir.create(ntl_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(h5_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

### Define ROI

```{r}
roi_sf <- gadm(country = "USA", level = 1, path = file.path(vol)) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  subset(NAME_1 == "Hawaii")

roi_sf
```

```{r}
for (period in names(all_dates)) {
  for (d in as.character(all_dates[[period]])) {
    tryCatch(
      bm_raster(roi_sf = roi_sf,
                product_id = "VNP46A2",
                variable = "Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL",
                quality_flag_rm = 2,
                date = as.Date(d),
                bearer = bearer,
                output_location_type = "file",
                file_dir = ntl_dir,
                h5_dir = h5_dir,
                file_skip_if_exists = TRUE),
      error = function(e) message("Skipped ", d, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
length(list.files(ntl_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$"))
length(list.files(h5_dir, pattern = "\\.h5$"))
```

returns 102 and 305\
